results.deliverable: A pinned-Java differential campaign for consume-transform-produce crash boundaries.

limits: Kafka transactions cover output records and committed input offsets only. External application effects are out of scope and are not exactly-once.
Native Apache Kafka 4.1.0 on loopback, not Docker and not a mixed-version topology.
Replacement fencing on Produce was INVALID_PRODUCER_EPOCH (47), not PRODUCER_FENCED (90).
crash_during_endtxn is atomic: this run committed. An abort of the same crash remains a valid outcome.
Transaction timeout (15s) is not a leader-recovery or request-timeout promise.
No cases.json rows were added (KL01-14 holds that write set).

failed_attempts.cause: kafka-topics --list succeeded before three brokers were registered, so RF=3 topic create failed closed.
The first worker only accepted PRODUCER_FENCED (90). Kafka 4.1 Produce on a stale transactional epoch returns INVALID_PRODUCER_EPOCH (47).
